name: Charmers And Charming
overview: Scripture clearly condemns the practice of charming and consulting with familiar spirits, identifying such acts as prohibited and linked with wizards and necromancers, as seen in Deuteronomy 18:11 and Isaiah 19:3. The Psalms illustrate the futility of charmers, describing how even the most skillful charmers cannot sway the deaf adder, symbolizing the ineffectiveness of such practices (Psalms 58:4-5). Furthermore, Jeremiah 8:17 warns that God will send serpents that cannot be charmed, emphasizing His sovereign power over those who rely on occult arts rather than Him.
